verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://docs.gusto.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured documentation index, and doc pages are served as raw .md that point to the full documentation index. Separately, the Gusto CLI repo ships a first-party AGENTS.md written for agents, and its README tells users to point their agent at it. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and independent community corroboration that agents use these docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.gusto.com/llms.txt # Embedded Payroll Documentation
Fetch the complete documentation index at:
Driving this with an agent? Point it at AGENTS.md — it covers install, auth login, and the conventions.
